answer: Tie standing to refundable collateral that vests only as established peers attest to a long record of honest work. A newcomer drifts in like a lone star in a vast nebula, sitting at zero weight until real history accrues, so a clone cannot inherit trust. Each fake must post its own bond and wait out its own vesting window, so N aliases cost N stakes and N windows. A watchful raven of auditors slashes bonds on detected collusion, and reputation hardens slowly, layer by layer, like an opal forming in stone.
